outcome: Gestational age at non-stress test start
cohort: 116 pregnancies complicated by gastroschisis between 2011 and 2020
finding: While several fetal bowel measurements were statistically associated with perinatal outcomes, the clinical impact of these findings was minimal.
mod_finding: Extra-abdominal bowel wall thickness in fetuses with gastroschisis was associated with a small increase in 5-minute APGAR scores and a small increase in umbilical artery base deficit.
